name: Relace Search
title: Relace Search: price, context window and specs
answer: Relace Search is a model in Relace's Relace family, first listed on 2025-12-08. It takes text in and returns text, with a context window of 256K tokens and up to 128K tokens of output. On the lowest-cost route in the OpenRouter catalog it costs $1 per million input tokens and $3 per million output tokens. Its weights are not published, so it is reached through an API.
compare: It is the newest of the 2 versions of Relace listed today.
Its input price is the family median, $1 per million tokens.
No version in the family has a larger context window.
